title: feat(spec,plugin-auth): advertise Developer Edition organization creation on /auth/config
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNd4arQxsEYhZ3uX42GCM21)_

Fixes #31990

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — the skills name the PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES registry, never its members

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`/auth/config` 的 `features` 新增可选布尔 `developerEditionCreate`,由宿主选项 `AuthManagerOptions.developerEditionCreate` 打开;不设时恒为 `false`。
- **为什么改**:云端已能按 `?edition=developer` 创建开发者版组织,但控制台无从得知;这是 #31988 拆分的 PR A,先把契约与宿主开关落地,控制台的勾选框(PR B)随后读它。
- **风险与回滚**:只是广告,本仓库无任何服务端行为读它;未设选项时 payload 只多一个 `false` 键。回滚即撤本 PR,控制台 PR B 尚未落地,无下游依赖。
- **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`(选项与 `features` 字面量那一行)、`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`(注册行)、`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`(schema 键)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/auth-manager.test.ts -t developerEditionCreate`,预期 1 passed(选项为 true 时下发 true,否则 false)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Spec contract.** `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`) gains `developerEditionCreate: z.boolean().optional()`, no default. Its description says it is true only where the host's organization-create door accepts `?edition=developer`, that it changes no server behaviour, and that absent or false means no developer choice is offered.
- **Registry.** One `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` row (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`): `surface: 'login'`, `semantics: 'opt-in'`, `exempt` (no spec input gates it; a host option sets it). `login` and not `crud`: the registry defines `login` as a flag read straight off `/auth/config` with no spec metadata in between, which is how the console create-organization form reads it. `multiOrgEnabled` is `crud` only because it gates `sys_organization` actions; this flag gates none.
- **plugin-auth.** `AuthManagerOptions.developerEditionCreate?: boolean` (default `false`), a TS-only host option documented beside `onOrganizationCreated`. `getPublicConfig()` serves it in its `features` literal as `this.config.developerEditionCreate === true`.
- **Served when unset: always, as `false`** (the `cloudManaged` precedent, ruled in claim amendment 1 on #31990). Serving the key only when true is not possible without weakening the drift guard: `public-feature-registry.test.ts` holds the served booleans at default config equal to the registry, refuses keys that appear or disappear with config, and requires an opt-in row to serve `false` by default. So the unset `features` object gains one `developerEditionCreate: false` key, and the two exact pins of the served shape gain one line each.
- **Regenerated.** `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (one line) and `content/docs/references/{api/auth-endpoints,data/object,ui/action}.mdx` (the new key, and the new `requiresFeature` enum value).

**Names for PR B (#31988):** `features.developerEditionCreate` on the client side, and `AuthManagerOptions.developerEditionCreate` for the host (cloud's half is that one option, per the cloud lane's answer on #31988). The name was re-read on #31988 before this PR opened: the cloud lane confirmed it (comment 6754499855).

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.test.ts`: new `serves features.developerEditionCreate from the host option` (true when set, false when set false, false when unset); the exact `getPublicConfig().features` pin gains `developerEditionCreate: false`.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.test.ts`: registry count 13 → 14 and the name list.
- `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.test.ts`: the served fixture names the new key; the registry-to-schema pin and the per-flag optional-boolean `it.each` pick the row up.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/public-feature-registry.test.ts` (drift guard): unchanged, green.

## Acceptance notes

- `Metadata-protocol: added`, not the brief's expected `none`: the registry row widens `z.enum(PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURE_NAMES)`, so `requiresFeature: 'developerEditionCreate'` is a new accepted value on actions, params and field groups. Same reading as the `emailDelivery` row's changeset. Ruled in claim amendment 1.
- The flag advertises a door that lives in cloud; nothing in this repository takes an edition. A host that sets the option without serving the door offers a choice its server ignores; the option's doc comment says so.
